requirements.title: IEEE_REAL argument restrictions
requirements.definition: A shall be integer or real; optional KIND shall be a scalar integer constant expression.

pending.IEEE_REAL-A-integer-or-real: Positive source controls probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) before IEEE_REAL(123) for the default result kind, IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5) and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0) before IEEE_REAL(1.5), and IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(1.5) plus IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0d0) before IEEE_REAL(1.5,KIND=KIND(0.0d0)); then the supported branches call IEEE_REAL with integer A and real A. Source-control mutation uses a nonnumeric A and claims no diagnostic facet.
pending.IEEE_REAL-KIND-scalar-integer-constant-e: Positive source controls probe IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0d0) before IEEE_REAL(123,KIND=KIND(0.0d0)) and use KIND=KIND(0.0d0) plus a named integer constant kind. Mutation uses a nonconstant KIND expression and claims no diagnostic facet.

requirements.definition: The result has the same value as A for values representable in the result representation method.

requirements.title: IEEE_REAL rounded conversions follow the active IEEE rounding operation
requirements.definition: Nonrepresentable integer and real conversions are rounded according to the rounding mode and are consistent with convertFromInt and convertFormat.

pending.IEEE_REAL-convertFromInt-rounded: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING for IEEE_UP and IEEE_DOWN on default real, and IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE observer support; supported branch saves original mode, sets IEEE_UP and GET confirms IEEE_UP before converting integer 16777217 to default binary32 under the ieee_binary profile and asserting 16777218.0, then sets IEEE_DOWN and GET confirms IEEE_DOWN before asserting 16777216.0, then restores the original mode and GET confirms restoration. Mutations swap the mode or expected neighbour.
pending.IEEE_REAL-convertFormat-rounded: Guarded branch probes IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0d0), IEEE_SUPPORT_DATATYPE(0.0), IEEE_SUPPORT_ROUNDING for IEEE_UP and IEEE_DOWN on default real, and IEEE_GET_ROUNDING_MODE observer support; supported branch saves original mode, sets IEEE_UP and GET confirms IEEE_UP before converting 1.0d0+2.0d0**(-24) to default binary32 under ieee_binary and asserting 1.0+2.0**(-23), then sets IEEE_DOWN and GET confirms IEEE_DOWN before asserting 1.0, then restores the original mode and GET confirms restoration. Mutations swap the rounding mode or midpoint input.

Argument restrictions are split into A type and KIND constant-expression fine units.
Invocation restriction combines A support and result support guards.

Example paragraph is illustrative; the exact integer conversion is already planned from p6.
